BiblicalUsage: Sechowq is laughter, and Ecclesiastes will not let it stand on its own: I said of laughter, It is mad; and of mirth, What doeth it? Sorrow is better than laughter, for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that laughter without meaning is madness to the Preacher, and sorrow that makes the heart better is worth more than a laugh that does nothing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
